components.title: Heritage Cluster (experimental)
components.description: Classic BMW instrument clusters on your car's digital cluster, in place of the stock dials: the E-series analogue cluster (X5 E53, 5 Series E39), the F-series digital display (X5 F15, X6 F16, 5 Series F10, 7 Series F01) in Comfort and Sport, and the F-series M analogue cluster (M3 F80, M4 F82) by night or day. For any iDrive 7 car with the 12.3-inch cluster. Built on a G05 X5, not yet tested in a car: try it parked first. Provided as is, without warranty.
components.author: 7amoody1985
